evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Quinton issues a directive establishing a recurring obligation — a command from rank that the team must comply with going forward.
Xena records the cadence as a decided mandate, ratifying the directive's authority-ranking force into the team's operational record.
Assigning a single named owner enacts hierarchy — one person holds rank-based responsibility and accountability for the rehearsals.

mints.name: MandateByAphorism
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the directive here entering as an aphoristic maxim that forecloses argument, rather than as an open proposal?
